This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|white]] and black skin, featuring pink patches,<ref name="Chapter 1" /> and mottled dark spots where the two primary colors met. They also had elongated craniums featuring four protruding knobs, as well as distinct [[Breath mask|masks]] covering their mouths and noses.<ref name="Sipe" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|1}}</ref> a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Nevarro)|member of this species]] served as a [[bounty hunter]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild|Guild]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]],<ref name="Chapter 1" /> though they were killed while attempting to take down the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]].<ref name="Chapter 3">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
